# Alert

> Inline feedback for a page section (status or error).

- **id:** `alert`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Report a result or problem next to the related content

### Don't use when

- A full-page failure (use error-state)
- A quiet tip in docs (use callout)

### Accessibility

- error tone uses role=alert; other tones use role=status; dismiss is named.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | enum(info | success | warning | error | brand | neutral) | no | — | `"info"` | — |
| `title` | string | no | — | — | Optional heading |
| `text` | string | no | untrusted | — | Body copy |
| `hideIcon` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `icon` | slot | no | — | — | Custom icon snippet |
| `actionLabel` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `actionHref` | string | no | developer | — | Optional action link (URL policy) |
| `onAction` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `dismissible` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `dismissLabel` | string | no | — | `"Dismiss"` | — |
| `onDismiss` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Warning alert (`warning`)

```json
{
  "tone": "warning",
  "title": "Check inventory",
  "text": "Three SKUs are low."
}
```

### Related

- [`callout`](components/callout.md)
- [`banner`](components/banner.md)
- [`error-state`](components/error-state.md)

# AlertDialog

> Modal confirm/cancel dialog for consequential actions.

- **id:** `alert-dialog`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

### Use when

- Confirm delete or irreversible actions
- Require an explicit choice

### Don't use when

- Informational copy without a choice (use dialog or toast)

### Accessibility

- Role alertdialog; focus trapped until confirm or cancel
- Destructive mode styles the confirm action and warning icon

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `title` | string | yes | — | — | — |
| `description` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `confirmLabel` | string | no | — | `"Confirm"` | — |
| `cancelLabel` | string | no | — | `"Cancel"` | — |
| `destructive` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `onConfirm` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onCancel` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `trigger` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `errorFallback` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `onOpenChange` | event | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Destructive confirm (`delete`)

```json
{
  "title": "Delete note?",
  "description": "This cannot be undone.",
  "destructive": true,
  "confirmLabel": "Delete",
  "open": true
}
```

### Related

- [`dialog`](components/dialog.md)
- [`toaster`](components/toaster.md)

# Badge

> A compact status or category label.

- **id:** `badge`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Show a short status or category next to a title

### Don't use when

- A removable filter (use tag)
- A toggleable filter chip (use chip)

### Accessibility

- Never convey meaning by color alone; pair with a word.
- In a catalog tree, set label (or put the word in an inline-text child).

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | enum(default | secondary | outline | success | warning | destructive | info | neutral) | no | — | `"default"` | — |
| `label` | string | no | — | — | Plain-text badge word, escaped; replaces children when both are given |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | The badge word (an inline-text node in a tree) |

### Examples

#### Success badge (`success`)

```json
{
  "variant": "success"
}
```

#### Labelled badge (`labelled`)

```json
{
  "variant": "info",
  "label": "Shipped"
}
```

### Related

- [`tag`](components/tag.md)
- [`chip`](components/chip.md)
- [`inline-text`](components/inline-text.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Banner

> Full-width notice across a page or app shell.

- **id:** `banner`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Announce a global condition (maintenance, trial)

### Don't use when

- Inline field errors (use alert near the field)

### Accessibility

- Same tone roles as Alert; dismiss control is optional and named.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | enum(info | success | warning | error | brand | neutral) | no | — | `"info"` | — |
| `title` | string | no | — | — | Optional heading |
| `text` | string | no | untrusted | — | Body copy |
| `hideIcon` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `icon` | slot | no | — | — | Custom icon snippet |
| `actionLabel` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `actionHref` | string | no | developer | — | Optional action link (URL policy) |
| `onAction` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `dismissible` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `dismissLabel` | string | no | — | `"Dismiss"` | — |
| `onDismiss` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Brand banner (`brand`)

```json
{
  "tone": "brand",
  "title": "New workspace",
  "text": "Invite teammates from Settings.",
  "dismissible": true
}
```

### Related

- Keep data available in the component-provided text or table alternative.

# Embed blocks

> Validated link previews (URL policy) and embed-app shells. Texuli never runs app JSON; hosts mount via mountEmbed with a sandboxed iframe contract.

- **id:** `blocks-embed`
- **package:** `@texuli/blocks`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `content`

### Use when

- Show a deferred mini-app shell where the host mounts after user Start.
- Show an offline link preview with HTTPS-only href (URL policy).

### Don't use when

- Application navigation, account controls or mutations.
- Running untrusted app JSON with innerHTML, eval, or an unsandboxed iframe.
- Relaxing iframe sandbox (especially adding allow-same-origin) or skipping CSP frame-src / postMessage origin checks.

### Accessibility

- Start control is a real button; nothing loads until activation.
- Iframe title (when used) names the embedded app; host must keep keyboard access inside the frame.
- Link previews use rel=noopener noreferrer on new-window links.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | object | yes | untrusted | — | Untrusted block data validated by the component before rendering. |
| `mountEmbed` | event | no | — | — | Host runtime after user Start. Prefer createSandboxedEmbedMount (sandbox without allow-same-origin, referrerpolicy=no-referrer, HTTPS allowlist). Host CSP frame-src + postMessage origin checks required; never relax sandbox or inject HTML from app data. |
| `labels` | object | no | — | — | — |
| `oninvalid` | event | no | — | — | Host-provided callback; omit when no host behavior is needed. |

### Examples

#### Embed blocks example (`basic`)

```json
{
  "block": {
    "type": "link-preview",
    "href": "https://example.com/guide",
    "title": "Product guide"
  }
}
```

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Breadcrumb

> Hierarchy trail with URL-policy links.

- **id:** `breadcrumb`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

### Use when

- Show location in a hierarchy

### Don't use when

- Primary navigation (use navigation-menu or sidebar)

### Accessibility

- nav landmark; current page is not a link.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | yes | — | — | BreadcrumbItem[] |
| `label` | string | no | — | `"Breadcrumb"` | — |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `separatorLabel` | string | no | — | `"Separator"` | — |
| `separator` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `maxItems` | number | no | — | `0` | — |
| `hrefTrust` | enum(developer | untrusted) | no | developer | `"developer"` | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Trail (`trail`)

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "label": "Workspace",
      "href": "https://example.com"
    },
    {
      "label": "Notes",
      "href": "https://example.com/notes"
    },
    {
      "label": "Harbor"
    }
  ]
}
```

# Button

> A pressable action control with loading and optional link rendering.

- **id:** `button`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Primary and secondary actions
- Submit and reset controls in forms

### Don't use when

- An icon-only control (use icon-button)
- A toggleable filter chip (use chip)
- Navigation that is not an action (use a link or nav item)

### Accessibility

- Real button or link element with an accessible name
- Busy state exposes aria-busy and disables further activation
- Rejected href schemes render as a non-interactive control

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | enum(default | secondary | outline | ghost | destructive | link) | no | — | `"default"` | — |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg | icon) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `href` | string | no | developer | — | Optional link target (URL policy) |
| `hrefTrust` | enum(developer | untrusted) | no | — | `"developer"` | — |
| `type` | enum(button | submit | reset) | no | — | `"button"` | — |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `loading` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `loadingLabel` | string | no | — | — | Accessible name while loading |
| `autoLoading` | boolean | no | — | `true` | Show pending when onclick returns a promise |
| `label` | string | no | — | — | Plain-text label, escaped; replaces children when both are given |
| `onclick` | event | no | — | — | Activated handler; may return a promise |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | The visible label (an inline-text node in a tree) |

### Examples

#### Default button (`default`)

```json
{
  "variant": "default"
}
```

#### Loading button (`loading`)

```json
{
  "loading": true,
  "loadingLabel": "Saving"
}
```

#### Labelled submit button (`labelled`)

```json
{
```

# ButtonGroup

> Groups related buttons with shared borders and orientation.

- **id:** `button-group`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Cluster related actions that share a single decision

### Don't use when

- Unrelated actions across a toolbar (use a plain flex row)

### Accessibility

- role=group with an optional accessible label.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | enum(horizontal | vertical) | no | — | `"horizontal"` | — |
| `attached` | boolean | no | — | `true` | Share borders between buttons |
| `label` | string | no | — | — | Accessible name for the group |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Attached horizontal group (`attached`)

```json
{
  "orientation": "horizontal",
  "attached": true,
  "label": "View mode"
}
```

# Callout

> Emphasized documentation-style tip with a strong start edge.

- **id:** `callout`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Highlight a tip or note beside prose

### Don't use when

- A blocking error (use alert with error tone)
- A site-wide notice (use banner)

### Accessibility

- Same tone roles as Alert; never color-only meaning.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | enum(info | success | warning | error | brand | neutral) | no | — | `"info"` | — |
| `title` | string | no | — | — | Optional heading |
| `text` | string | no | untrusted | — | Body copy |
| `hideIcon` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `icon` | slot | no | — | — | Custom icon snippet |
| `actionLabel` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `actionHref` | string | no | developer | — | Optional action link (URL policy) |
| `onAction` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `dismissible` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `dismissLabel` | string | no | — | `"Dismiss"` | — |
| `onDismiss` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Info callout (`info-tip`)

```json
{
  "tone": "info",
  "title": "Tip",

```

# Card

> A surface for grouping related content with optional link behavior.

- **id:** `card`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Group related content in a bordered surface
- Make a whole tile a single link

### Don't use when

- A single line of chrome (use badge or button)
- A data grid of many rows (use table)

### Accessibility

- When href is set, the card is a real link with an accessible name
- Rejected href schemes render as a non-interactive surface

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | enum(elevated | flat) | no | — | `"elevated"` | Visual elevation |
| `href` | string | no | developer | — | Optional link target (URL policy) |
| `hrefTrust` | enum(developer | untrusted) | no | — | `"developer"` | — |
| `linkLabel` | string | no | — | — | Accessible name when the card is a link |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | Extra classes |

### Examples

#### Elevated card (`elevated`)

```json
{
  "variant": "elevated"
}
```

#### Linked card (`linked`)

```json
{
  "variant": "flat",
  "href": "https://example.com/docs",
  "linkLabel": "Open documentation"
}
```

### Related

- [`button`](components/button.md)
- [`stat`](components/stat.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Combobox

> A text input that filters a list of options, for one value or several.

- **id:** `combobox`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Pick from a long list by typing to filter
- Options loaded from a server as the user types

### Don't use when

- A short closed list (use select or radio-group)
- Several values shown as chips (use multi-select)

### Accessibility

- The input keeps focus; aria-activedescendant tracks the highlighted option
- Arrow keys move, Enter selects, Escape closes; empty, loading and error states are announced
- With required, a rejected form moves focus to the input

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | unknown | no | — | — | Selected value (a string, or a string array when multiple) |
| `defaultValue` | unknown | no | — | — | Starting selection; a form reset restores it |
| `inputValue` | string | no | — | — | Text in the input (bindable) |
| `defaultInputValue` | string | no | — | `""` | — |
| `items` | array | no | — | — | Options as { value, label, disabled? } |
| `loadOptions` | unknown | no | — | — | Function prop the host passes: (query, signal) => Promise<items> for remote options. Not agent-emittable (functions are not data). |
| `filter` | unknown | no | — | — | Function prop the host passes: (item, query) => boolean. Replaces the default match (label contains the query, ignoring case); runs on the trimmed, non-empty query; unused with loadOptions. createFoldedFilter builds an accent-insensitive one. Not agent-emittable (functions are not data). |
| `multiple` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Not interactive, not submitted, not validated |
| `name` | string | no | — | — | Form field name: submits the value (one entry per value when multiple) |
| `required` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Blocks form submission until a value is selected |
| `requiredMessage` | string | no | — | — | Translated message when required blocks submission (default: the browser message) |
| `form` | string | no | — | — | Associated form id |
| `open` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `variant` | enum(outline | soft) | no | — | `"outline"` | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `onValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onInputValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onOpenChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Required form field (`form-field`)

```json
{
  "name": "city",
  "required": true,
  "requiredMessage": "Choose a city.",
  "size": "md"
}
```

### Related

- [`multi-select`](components/multi-select.md)
- [`select`](components/select.md)
- [`field`](components/field.md)
- [`form`](components/form.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

- **id:** `deck-slide`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted

### Don't use when

- No HTML strings; children are nested catalog nodes

### Props

| `title` | string | no | untrusted | — | — |
| `notes` | string | no | untrusted | — | Plain-text speaker notes |
| `master` | enum(title | section | content | two-column | media-left | media-right | quote | closing) | no | — | — | — |
| `transition` | enum(none | fade | fade-up) | no | — | — | — |
| `themeRef` | unknown | no | — | — | Overrides the deck theme for this slide |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

```json
  "slideId": "opening",
```

# Dialog

> Modal dialog with title, optional description, body and footer.

- **id:** `dialog`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

### Use when

- Confirm multi-step flows
- Show focused detail without leaving the page

### Don't use when

- A destructive confirm that must trap attention (use alert-dialog)
- Non-modal hints (use popover or tooltip)

### Accessibility

- Focus moves into the dialog and returns on close
- Title is required; Escape dismisses unless prevented

| `footer` | slot | no | — | — | — |

| `hideClose` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `closeLabel` | string | no | — | `"Close"` | — |
| `onOpenChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

# Form

> A form shell with layout, validation hook and error map.

- **id:** `form`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Collect and validate a set of fields before submit

### Don't use when

- A single control with no submit (use field alone)

### Accessibility

- Native constraint validation runs unless noValidate is set
- Field errors map back onto controls after onValidate

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | enum(stack | grid) | no | — | `"stack"` | — |
| `noValidate` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `onValidate` | event | no | — | — | Return a field→message map (or Promise) to block submit |
| `onSubmitValues` | event | no | — | — | Called after validation succeeds with FormData values |
| `errors` | object | no | — | — | Controlled field→message map (bind:errors) |
| `onErrorsChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `formError` | slot | no | — | — | Form-level error snippet (e.g. _form message) |

### Examples

#### Stacked form (`stack`)

```json
{
  "layout": "stack"
}
```

# Inline text

> A plain text run for the slot of a slot-only component (button, label, badge).

- **id:** `inline-text`
- **package:** `@texuli/catalog`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Give a form label, description, field error or menu trigger its visible text
- Text for a button, badge or kbd when the tree prefers a child to the label prop
- Any slot that needs a short phrase rather than a block

### Don't use when

- A paragraph, heading or list (use blocks-text)
- Text that needs formatting or links (use blocks-text)
- A component that already has a label or title prop (set that prop)

### Accessibility

- Painted as one escaped text node, so it names the parent control (a button label)
- A leaf: children are dropped

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes | — | — | Plain text; the renderer refuses markup-like strings |

### Examples

#### Button label (`button-label`)

```json
{
  "text": "Save changes"
}
```

#### Badge word (`badge-word`)

```json
{
  "text": "Shipped"
}
```

### Related

- [`button`](components/button.md)
- [`label`](components/label.md)
- [`badge`](components/badge.md)
- [`kbd`](components/kbd.md)

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# MultiSelect

> A combobox for several values, shown as removable chips.

- **id:** `multi-select`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Choose several values from a long list by typing

### Don't use when

- One value (use combobox or select)
- A few independent options (use checkbox)

### Accessibility

- Chips can be removed with their button or Backspace from an empty input
- Submits one form entry per selected value

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | unknown | no | — | — | Selected value (a string, or a string array when multiple) |
| `defaultValue` | unknown | no | — | — | Starting selection; a form reset restores it |
| `inputValue` | string | no | — | — | Text in the input (bindable) |
| `defaultInputValue` | string | no | — | `""` | — |
| `items` | array | no | — | — | Options as { value, label, disabled? } |
| `loadOptions` | unknown | no | — | — | Function prop the host passes: (query, signal) => Promise<items> for remote options. Not agent-emittable (functions are not data). |
| `filter` | unknown | no | — | — | Function prop the host passes: (item, query) => boolean. Replaces the default match (label contains the query, ignoring case); runs on the trimmed, non-empty query; unused with loadOptions. createFoldedFilter builds an accent-insensitive one. Not agent-emittable (functions are not data). |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Not interactive, not submitted, not validated |
| `name` | string | no | — | — | Form field name: submits the value (one entry per value when multiple) |
| `required` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Blocks form submission until a value is selected |
| `requiredMessage` | string | no | — | — | Translated message when required blocks submission (default: the browser message) |
| `form` | string | no | — | — | Associated form id |
| `open` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `variant` | enum(outline | soft) | no | — | `"outline"` | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `onValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onInputValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onOpenChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Tags field (`tags`)

```json
{
  "name": "tags",
  "variant": "outline",
  "size": "md"
}
```

# Select

> A single-value select root with size and variant chrome.

- **id:** `select`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Pick one value from a moderate closed list

### Don't use when

- A short exclusive set that fits on the page (use radio-group)
- Free text with suggestions (use combobox)

### Accessibility

- Trigger is a real button; listbox opens on ArrowDown/Enter/Space
- Typeahead highlights matching items; Escape closes and restores focus

| `modal` | boolean | no | — | `true` | false: a non-modal panel (no focus trap, inert or scroll lock) |
| `dismissOutside` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Non-modal only: close on a press or focus outside (never on the trigger) |
| `closeOnEscape` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Non-modal only: close on Escape anywhere, not just from inside |

# Table

> A responsive data table with density, stacking and sticky header options.

- **id:** `table`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Tabular comparison of many rows and columns

### Don't use when

- A single metric (use stat or kpi)
- A free-form card layout

### Accessibility

- Real table markup with caption or label for the scroll region
- Stacked mode keeps labels associated with cells
- busy sets aria-busy on the table

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | enum(plain | striped | grid) | no | — | `"plain"` | — |
| `density` | enum(compact | default | comfortable) | no | — | `"default"` | — |
| `stack` | enum(never | sm | md) | no | — | `"never"` | Stack rows into labelled cards when the container is narrow |
| `stickyHeader` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `maxBlockSize` | string | no | — | — | CSS length capping height so the body scrolls |
| `label` | string | no | — | — | Accessible name for the scroll area |
| `busy` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `wrapperClass` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Striped sticky header (`striped-sticky`)

```json
{
  "variant": "striped",
  "stickyHeader": true,
  "stack": "sm",
  "label": "Orders"
}
```

# TextCounter

> An input or textarea that shows remaining characters near the limit.

- **id:** `text-counter`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

- Bounded free-text with a visible remaining count

### Don't use when

### Accessibility

# Timeline

> Vertical or horizontal chronological list of events.

- **id:** `timeline`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Show a sequence of events with status

### Don't use when

- A Gantt schedule with dependencies (use @texuli/data/timeline)

### Accessibility

- Ordered list with an accessible name
- Status has a spoken word and marker shape, not color alone
- Item links pass the URL policy

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | no | — | — | Data-driven items (or compose TimelineItem children) |
| `orientation` | enum(vertical | horizontal) | no | — | `"vertical"` | — |
| `label` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `messages` | object | no | — | — | Localized label/status words |
| `hrefTrust` | enum(developer | untrusted) | no | — | `"developer"` | — |
| `item` | slot | no | — | — | Extra content under each data item |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Shipment timeline (`shipment`)

```json
{
  "orientation": "vertical",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "1",
      "title": "Packed",
      "time": "Mon",
      "status": "complete"
    },
    {
      "id": "2",
      "title": "In transit",
      "time": "Tue",
      "status": "current"
    },
    {
      "id": "3",
      "title": "Delivered",
      "time": "Wed",
      "status": "upcoming"
    }
  ]
}
```

# Toaster

> Live region that renders toast notifications from the shared store.

- **id:** `toaster`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

### Use when

### Don't use when

| `position` | enum(top-start | top-center | top-end | bottom-start | bottom-center | bottom-end) | no | — | `"bottom-end"` | Block edge and logical inline position; narrow screens center the stack |
| `offset` | string | no | — | — | CSS length or px number from the stack edge |
| `store` | unknown | no | — | — | Optional ToastStore inject (tests) |
| `dismissLabel` | string | no | — | `"Dismiss notification"` | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

# Tooltip

> Short delayed hint on hover or focus.

- **id:** `tooltip`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

### Use when

- Icon-only controls need a name
- Optional keyboard shortcut hints

### Don't use when

- Essential instructions (put them in visible copy)

### Accessibility

- Shows on focus; content is plain text or a snippet, never a sink.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | string | yes | — | — | Hint text or rich snippet |
| `children` | slot | yes | — | — | Trigger snippet { props } |
| `shortcut` | string | no | — | — | Shortcut string or list shown as Kbd |
| `side` | enum(top | right | bottom | left) | no | — | `"top"` | — |
| `align` | enum(start | center | end) | no | — | `"center"` | — |
| `sideOffset` | number | no | — | `6` | — |
| `delayDuration` | number | no | — | `300` | — |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `open` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Basic tooltip (`basic`)

```json
{
  "content": "Save note",
  "side": "top"
}
```
